notes.title: Improved Achievement Sync
notes.notes:
We've released an update to speed up the synchronization of earned achievements on the game’s store page. 
We're doing everything we can to ensure players don't lose their progress. 
Thank you for your help in identifying this issue and for your patience while we worked to resolve it.
